cable: Short USB-A plug to micro-USB plug cable into ESP32-CAM-MB base; use low-resistance power conductors, target <=0.2 m. Validate voltage at the complete camera assembly under startup, flash and Wi-Fi activity.
data_interface: J6 is camera power only, not a USB host or USB charging port. D+/D- are intentionally NC. Wi-Fi image transfer needs suitable firmware; current repository camera firmware is diagnostic and does not implement a streaming server.
source: J2 regulated 5 V -> F1 pin 1 -> F1 pin 2 -> independent branch -> J6 pin 1
input_supply_target: regulated 5 V, 2 A capable; shared fuse and thermal constraints still apply

routing.resistance_calculation_scope: Conservative sum of all new power segments including parallel and bypass branches at 20C, nominal 35um copper. Excludes vias, planes, upstream copper, contacts, fuse and cable; not thermal qualification.

decoupling.component_selection: Nominal specifications; final MPN and effective capacitance under DC bias to be checked

mechanical.mounting: Four SMD contacts with two through-hole shell anchors
mechanical.fit_validation: Manufacturer drawing has 3.61 mm shell legs; retention and soldering on the selected 1.6 mm board must be confirmed with actual parts before fabrication release.
mechanical.local_footprint_change: Only three front-flange silkscreen segments moved to F.Fab to clear board edge; pads and model unchanged from KiCad library.
